opening.quote: Good afternoon, tidal Home, fem key speaking. who can help?
opening.comment: The agent gave a greeting and the company name (heard as 'tidal Home'), but the agent's own name was garbled and is unclear; the greeting does not clearly give the agent's name.

verification.comment: The agent never confirmed the caller's full name or postcode alongside the order number before cancelling and sharing order details.

understanding.quote: Customer: white, no, I didn't want to cancel or of a. I wanted to change the sizes to medium.
understanding.comment: The caller clearly said they wanted to change the size to medium, but the agent cancelled the order anyway and dismissed the caller's correction with 'You said cancel.'

resolution_accuracy.quote: The order hadn't been despatch, so cancellin is free, and €69.00 goes back to your card in 2 to 9 working this.
resolution_accuracy.comment: Cancellation before dispatch is free, but the refund timeline should be 3 to 5 working days, not 2 to 9, and the agent wrongly cancelled an order the caller did not want cancelled.

process_compliance.comment: No caller permission was sought before any hold, and no size-change process was followed; the agent cancelled instead of helping change the order, so the required steps were not met.

communication.quote: Customer: ...I'm a bit panicked about at.
communication.comment: The caller said they were panicked, but the agent did not acknowledge this and responded curtly with 'You said cancel.' and 'You'll half to order...yourselfs.'

closing.quote: Agent: Thank you for calling tide well. Goodbye.
closing.comment: The agent did not confirm the next steps clearly or ask if there was anything else; the caller had to ask what happens next, and the agent ended abruptly.
